processing.aggregation: All available training trace rows for each WAFER_ID × STAGE, arithmetic mean; no active-phase filter; complete mirrored training file collection merged before grouping.
processing.timestamp: maximum original scaled TIMESTAMP per wafer-stage; ordering value, not calendar date
processing.zero_rows: retained; zero sensor values are not labeled as failures
processing.provenance: Public secondary mirror; source description checked against PHM Society. Not claimed to be Samsung/SK Hynix data.
